name: task-lifecycle
description: An intent-triggered, Markdown-first lifecycle for governed Feature, Bugfix, and Docs work, with human approval, review evidence, and safe recovery.

interface.longDescription: Plan, review, and track Feature, Bugfix, and Docs tasks using explicit approvals, evidence-aware quality gates, and portable Markdown artifacts. Also supports read-only code, PR, and plan review. No automatic source edits or external actions without authorization. Skills-only: no MCP server, background service, or remote API.
defaultPrompt: Use Task Lifecycle for this project. Inspect read-only, reuse valid choices and host permissions, and ask for depth only when a formal task or plan requires it.
Use Task Lifecycle to plan a bugfix: reproduce, find the root cause, then propose a fix.
Use Task Lifecycle to review this PR read-only and list findings with evidence.
